messages.name: Soylent Corp admin
messages.body: Our HMAC check on X-InvoicePilot-Signature always fails.

messages.name: Maya (Support)
messages.body: Sign the X-InvoicePilot-Timestamp value, a dot, and the raw request body, using your whsec_ secret with HMAC-SHA256. Don't re-serialize the JSON. Also reject timestamps older than 5 minutes. The Python SDK has client.webhooks.verify_signature for this.
